title: Test native-math-settlement
summary: Run a bounded uncertainty-reduction experiment for: Animated mathematical fragments may move independently, but exact native KaTeX owns the settled expression and its typography and spacing. Selection rationale: The user approved a bounded real-KaTeX glyph compositor experiment to test native fragment motion and exact settlement before any family rollout.

expectedLearning: Whether actual computed-style KaTeX fragments eliminate the crossfade and character-substitution failure in solve-x.
Whether one generic ownership, handoff, and reflow compositor can later cover merge and split without operation-specific scheduling.
allowedWork: Build the approved isolated real-KaTeX solve-x compositor through slice 12 using existing semantic lineage and material-layer infrastructure.
After explicit human promotion, generalize the same compositor to the approved fraction merge, plus-minus split, and crowded responsive cases.
disallowedWork: No operation-specific scheduling, durable glyph geometry, clone interaction authority, radical repair, family rollout, Manim runtime, CAS, live LLM API, or unrelated work.
